description: Indicative price for swapping one token for another on Base via a DEX aggregator, including the 1% CoinFactory fee, aggregator fees, route, and the buy token's risk level. Read-only; builds nothing. Non-custodial: CoinFactory returns aggregator calldata only and never holds funds or keys; the taker wallet signs and broadcasts. A 1% CoinFactory fee plus aggregator fees and gas apply and are shown in the quote. Trades are irreversible. This is not financial advice.

sellAmount.description: Amount of sellToken in human units, e.g. '0.5'

sellToken.description: 'ETH', a Base contract address, a symbol, or a CoinGecko id

taker.description: Optional wallet address, improves accuracy of balance/allowance issues

name: get_swap_quote
title: Get swap quote (Base)
